overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Dec. 22, 2014 license renewal topic was sufficiently specific. The AG separately raised concern about inaccurate minutes and recommended revision, without finding a violation.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Dec. 22, 2014 notice topic on 2015 license renewals was not specific enough, because it did not say the Board would vote on amended applications.
allegations.key_passage: While additional information about the fact that the Board planned to vote on changes to these applications may have been helpful, we find  that the posted topic sufficiently described the anticipated discussion

allegations.summary: Complainant noted the Board did not post its usual packet of meeting materials, which listed the amended renewals, before the meeting.

allegations.summary: Not raised in the complaint; the AG itself noted that the Dec. 22, 2014 minutes did not accurately describe the discussion, which had no discussion of reasons for the vote.
allegations.key_passage: The description of the Town Manager's comments, while offering useful contextual background, does not accurately reflect the discussion that occurred during the meeting.
